cities.name: Onitsha
cities.summary: No anonymous Onitsha parcel polygons. Official services expose land records, but the linked printout concerns owner/history data and was not queried.

cities.name: Kano
cities.summary: No anonymous parcel geometry was verified. The tested KANGIS Buildings FeatureServer root returned ArcGIS JSON error 499 Token Required; this finding applies only to that endpoint. The ministry land host linked by KANGIS was inaccessible (Cloudflare 403); other services were not established as token-gated.

cities.name: Yaoundé
cities.summary: No credible anonymous parcel geometry; third-party Urban model contains a 32-shape sub-100m² microcluster, not usable city coverage.

limitations: Bounded public-source search; registry existence does not imply open geometry or full coverage.
